content.short: Falcon Finance lets you post almost any liquid asset as collateral to mint USDf, then stake it as sUSDf for yield.
content.description: Falcon Finance calls itself universal collateral infrastructure. Users deposit stablecoins, blue-chip tokens or selected altcoins and receive USDf, a synthetic dollar worth less than the collateral behind it. Staking USDf produces sUSDf, which earns from basis trades and other institutional strategies. That lets a fund or treasury raise dollar liquidity from assets it wants to keep holding, and earn on that liquidity at the same time. Beyond the synthetic dollar, the ecosystem includes the FF governance token and its staked form, a points programme called Falcon Miles, a Falcon Card and an insurance fund, with a transparency page showing reserves.
